description: Official-source visitor essentials for common Ranchi place and family queries.

entities.name: Nakshatra Van
entities.description: Nakshatra Van is a thematic park in Ranchi near Raj Bhawan, created by the Jharkhand Forest Department.

entities.name: Ranchi Lake
entities.description: Ranchi Lake is a historic lake in the heart of Ranchi near Main Road and Marwari College.

entities.name: Patratu Valley
entities.description: Patratu Valley is a scenic valley around 40 km from Ranchi, known for greenery, misty hills and winding roads.

entities.name: Sidhu and Kanhu Park
entities.description: Sidhu and Kanhu Park is a city park in Ranchi with children's swings and an open gym.

entities.name: Biodiversity Park Ranchi
entities.description: Biodiversity Park in Ranchi is managed by the forest department and includes plant-focused gardens, trails and a children's park.

facts.value: Children's park, gardens, artificial hillocks, waterfalls, a musical fountain and a medicinal-plant garden.
facts.evidence: The official Forest Department places-to-visit page lists children's parks, gardens, artificial hillocks, waterfalls, a musical fountain and medicinal plants at Nakshatra Van.

facts.value: Ranchi Lake was excavated by Colonel Onsely in 1842.
facts.evidence: Jharkhand Tourism states that Ranchi Lake was excavated by Colonel Onsely in 1842.

facts.value: Near Ranchi Main Road and Marwari College, about 4.5 km from Ranchi railway station.
facts.evidence: Jharkhand Tourism places the lake near Main Road and Marwari College and about 4.5 km from Ranchi railway station.
